V. 25.
When the heaven was ſhut up three years and ſix months— Such a Proof had they, that GOD had ſent him. In 1 Kings xviii. 1. it is ſaid, The word of the Lord come to Elijah in the third year: Namely, reckoning not from the Beginning of the Drought, but from the Time when he began to ſojourn with the Widow of Sarepta. A Year of Drought had preceded this, while he dwelt at the Brook Cherith. So that the whole Time of the Drought was (as St. James likewiſe obſerves) three Years and ſix Months.
